pieces.purpose: Stacks children top to bottom.
Children in 2 to 4 equal columns, one column under 360 px.
pieces.example: <grid columns={3}><number label="Open" value={3} /><number label="Done" value={9} /><number label="Failed" value={0} /></grid>

pieces.purpose: Places children side by side.
A titled group, optionally collapsible.

open.about: open={false} starts it shut; open={$open} also keeps it

pieces.fallback: children under a text with the title

pieces.purpose: A line or a paragraph; a text child with {holes} fills a sentence.
A heading on the app's type ladder: title, section, or label in small caps.
Rich text, sanitised; images are not fetched.
pieces.example: <markdown>**Why.** The host keeps the last 5,000 events.</markdown>

pieces.purpose: A figure with a label.

trend.about: read in the sketch alone; the panel's stat cell draws its figure alone, so a trend the person sees is a sparkline beside it

pieces.purpose: One value against a maximum.
Categories compared as rows of name, track and figure; never a series over time.

key.unseen: names a row so it keeps its place as rows move

pieces.purpose: Lines over a list, oldest first; stack piles the <series>.

x.about: a time on x (ISO or ms) labels the axis by clock, in this computer's time zone; a number by its value

pieces.purpose: A Mermaid diagram: a flow, a sequence or a state machine; value={`...${$step}`} shows the live step.

value.about: Mermaid source; a text child is taken as written, braces and all. Labels a few words, decisions short questions; detail goes in a text beside it. Under about 15 nodes; past that, split it or summarize

pieces.example:
<diagram label="Deploy" value={`flowchart LR
  build --> test --> ship
  classDef now stroke-width:3px
  class ${$step} now`} />

pieces.purpose: Spans on a clock, Gantt style, such as a run's steps or a deploy's phases.

start.about: a time, ISO or ms; none waits

group.about: rows of one group sit under its name

now.about: where a running span ends; the clock if unset

pieces.example: <timeline label="CI run" items={$steps} name={item.name} start={item.started} end={item.ended} group={item.job} />

pieces.purpose: Sizes of one whole's parts as nested boxes, such as a bundle by module within package.
pieces.example: <treemap label="Bundle" items={$stats.json.modules} name={item.name} value={item.bytes} group={item.package} format="bytes" />

pieces.purpose: Shares of one whole, five parts at most with the rest as Other; never a series over time.
pieces.example: <donut label="By country" items={$countries} name={item.name} value={item.n} format="integer" />

pieces.purpose: A picture from a file on the thread's computer, such as a screenshot or a saved plot, or from an https address once the person allows its domain; opens large to zoom.

src.about: a path on the thread's computer, relative to its folder or whole, or an http(s) address; PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP up to 10 MB

pieces.purpose: Several pictures, as image takes them: a row that scrolls, a grid, or a before and after under a slider.
pieces.example: <images layout="compare" items={[{ p: "shots/before.png", c: "Before" }, { p: "shots/after.png", c: "After" }]} src={item.p} caption={item.c} />

pieces.purpose: A small line beside text, the way to show a figure's trend.
Rows with columns from a bound list: <col> per column, <action> per row button.

key.unseen: names a row so it keeps its place as rows move

pieces.purpose: Rows with a tick; editable writes the tick back to the value.

key.unseen: names a row so it keeps its place as rows move

state.unseen: this build's checklist draws done alone

pieces.purpose: Label and value pairs: <fact> per pair.
A dot in a tone with a word: Live, Down, Waiting.
A short fact in a small framed chip.
Progress as a ring with its figure inside.
A run's output as it streams, with its state and a Cancel.

lines.about: how many of the newest lines show, out then err, 8 by default

pieces.purpose: An action the person presses. held is a sentence that disables it: bind it to a condition.
pieces.example: <button label="Next" variant="primary" held={$ok ? null : 'Check the id first'} onPress={set($step, 2)} />

pieces.purpose: Text in, written to its $value as the person types; a secret's input is a password field.
One choice from options, written to its $value.
Large options to pick one, written to its $value; answer marks the right one once picked.
pieces.example: <choices label="Which layer routes packets?" value={$pick} options={$q.options} answer={$q.answer} />

pieces.purpose: An on/off switch written to its boolean $value.
An empty state, with at most one button under it.
pieces.example: <empty when={pr.number == null} title="No pull request yet">This branch has none.</empty>

sources.name: thread
sources.purpose: This thread: status, last turn, context, cost, tokens, changes, plan.
notes: the latest turn that reports it; null on an agent that does not

sources.name: tree
sources.purpose: The thread's root and every thread under it.

sources.name: usage
sources.purpose: The plan windows of the account the thread runs on.
sources.scope: the account the thread runs on
notes: Claude Code and Codex report them; a keyed sign-in has none and usage.note says why

sources.name: cost
sources.purpose: What the thread's computer costs: the rate now and what it has run up.
sources.scope: the computer the thread runs on
notes: 0 on this computer, which usd() reads as free

sources.name: time
sources.purpose: The clock, so a countdown or an age moves on its own.
notes: ms epoch; ticks each second while a visible piece reads it

sources.name: git
sources.purpose: The thread's checkout: branch, head, counts against upstream.
sources.cost: none for the checkout; status entries poll 15 s while bound
notes: null on a folder that is not a checkout

sources.name: pr
sources.purpose: The pull request of the thread's branch and its checks.
sources.cost: one gh read every 3 min; every 30 s while a bound check is pending
notes: null while the branch has no pull request
the head commit's subject; there is no pr.title

sources.name: machine
sources.purpose: The thread's computer: load, memory, disk and their last minute.
sources.cost: one sample a second while bound

sources.name: processes
sources.cost: one snapshot every 2 s while bound

sources.name: ports
sources.purpose: Ports open on the thread's computer.

sources.name: notifications
sources.purpose: The last 20 notices for this thread and its account.

sources.name: mcp
sources.purpose: The thread's agent's MCP servers: consent state, tools, resources.
sources.scope: servers configured for the thread's agent
